current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first memory, skill, and trivial date probes through the default PowerShell tool host repeatedly exceeded their bounds without producing output.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Switch to the Node-backed filesystem and direct child-process surface, then use no-profile PowerShell only for narrow Windows-native inspection.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Test the shell host with one trivial bounded probe and change command surface after a no-output timeout instead of repeating compound reads.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: A combined source head, branch, upstream, status, divergence, and shallow-state probe exceeded the Node tool's thirty-second outer bound.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Split revision, tracked cleanliness, complete cleanliness, tracking equality, and live-remote checks into isolated scalar probes with explicit outer bounds.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Never combine large-worktree status traversal with unrelated revision and remote checks under the default outer timeout.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: A breadth-first search across the D-drive archive for an external exact-final receipt exceeded its two-minute bound.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Narrow verification to the exact source worktree, committed receipts, known validation roots, and declared receipt digests.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not recursively search the full archive when exact branches, paths, hashes, and manifest contracts already delimit the evidence.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first 732-entry manifest audit scoped Git tree maps to the phase directory and falsely reported missing script and test blobs.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Build each manifest comparison map from the complete declared commit tree while retaining the manifest entry allowlist.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Manifest entries may span phase docs, scripts, and tests; scope by the manifest paths, not by one directory prefix.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: An early status probe ran while the original large checkout was still populating the worktree and exceeded its four-megabyte output cap.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Inspect the original Git PID and worktree index, wait for that one checkout to end, then run one full clean-state probe.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not interpret a partially populated worktree status as final state or retry worktree creation while the original process remains active.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: The legacy WMIC process-inspection command was unavailable and returned ENOENT.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Use tasklist plus no-profile Get-CimInstance for bounded Windows process inspection.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Detect the available Windows process-inspection surface before relying on legacy WMIC.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: A combined Git, Python, Node, Codex, and desktop-package version probe failed process-spawn validation before returning evidence.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Run each executable separately and read package metadata through a literal path.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Keep Windows command wrappers and executable probes isolated so one invalid launch cannot erase all version evidence.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: Direct execution of the desktop-bundled Codex binary was denied by the application package boundary.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Use the installed npm package metadata for CLI version and the verified WindowsApps package path for desktop version without executing the packaged binary.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Treat desktop package inspection as status-only and never bypass application-package execution controls.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first x1 build stopped because seven new proposal titles met or exceeded the 0.60 token-set Jaccard collision threshold against inherited wetland-era titles.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Retain the failed build, revise only the seven colliding titles with domain-specific vocabulary, and rerun the isolated x1 builder.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Run inherited-title collision screening before freezing x1 and treat domain substitution inside an inherited sentence frame as a collision rather than novelty.

current_x1_operational_negatives.observed: The first proposal-title inspection attempted to print Māori text through the default Windows cp1252 console and raised UnicodeEncodeError.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recovery: Repeat the narrow inspection with JSON ASCII escaping or an explicitly UTF-8 output surface.
current_x1_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Use UTF-8 output or JSON ASCII escaping whenever Windows command output may contain Māori or other non-cp1252 text.

inherited_postfinal_route_negative.observed: A post-final task-list call rejected the unsupported query argument. The validated repository and its sealed register were not changed.
